summary: Feed s168_triple to IDS is degraded: 41.7% one-way TCP sessions, microbursts to 1.57 Gbps over 1 Gbps port, and 73.6% encrypted traffic exceeds IDS tolerance. IDS lacks bidirectional visibility and is dropping during bursts with limited payload inspection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering only one direction for 85 of 204 TCP sessions (41.7%). Most likely asymmetric routing with single-sided SPAN or separate RX/TX TAPs not aggregated to the same IDS tool port, so return path goes to different broker port or is filtered.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs both directions (needs_both_directions=true) for stateful TCP reassembly and signature matching. One-way flows prevent handshake/sequence tracking, causing missed detections, false negatives, and broken stream reassembly.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate both directions of each flow to the same IDS port using flow-aware aggregation so the IDS sees client->server and server->client together.

findings.root_cause: Traffic microbursts peak at 1.57 Gbps in 1ms intervals vs 1 Gbps IDS port (157% of capacity, 6 overloaded intervals). Broker is forwarding line-rate bursts without shaping or load-balancing to a single 1G tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS port overrun causes buffer drops and packet loss during bursts. IDS misses packets needed for detection, creates blind spots and incomplete flows exactly when traffic is heaviest.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute flows across multiple 1G IDS ports or a higher-capacity tool cluster with flow-aware load balancing to keep per-port rate <80% and eliminate burst drops.

findings.root_cause: 73.6% of bytes are encrypted vs IDS tolerance of 60%. Traffic is predominantly TLS/encrypted with no broker-level decryption or selective forwarding, so IDS receives opaque payloads it cannot inspect (needs_full_payload=true).
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot inspect encrypted payloads for signatures, malware, or C2 detection. Effective detection coverage drops proportionally to encrypted share, leaving ~74% of bytes uninspected.

recommended_fix.why: Add selective TLS decryption / SSL visibility or route decrypted copy to IDS, or filter to send only decryptable/policy-relevant traffic to keep encrypted share below 60% for this IDS.
